description: Stats NZ publishes counts and measures for dwellings from the 2013, 2018 and 2023 censuses for all 33,164 statistical area 1 (SA1) units of New Zealand in its geographic data service, with the boundaries attached. For occupied private dwellings the layer gives access to basic amenities, dampness, mould, occupancy status, dwelling type, the fuel types used to heat the dwelling and the main types of heating, and the number and average of bedrooms and rooms. Sister layers give the same topics by statistical area 2, a 2023 housing data layer by SA2, and a 2023 table of main means of travel to work between SA2 of residence and workplace. The SA1 layer was published on 18 December 2024. Format and access: vector layer with coded columns and a lookup file, exported through the Koordinates-based service or read through its API; creating an export needs a free account (the export API answered 401 without credentials). Licence: CC BY 4.0, free. Caveats: earlier census counts were recoded to 2023 boundaries and may differ from the figures first published, time series need care, and the VAR codes need the lookup file. Simulation uses: small-area housing condition, heating fuel and amenity access for energy demand, health and retrofit models, and exposure. Related records: IPUMS International and the WorldPop population grid.
